text: I think you might enjoy this Creamy Oven-Baked Risotto recipe, given your fondness for creamy and comforting dishes. The use of arborio rice and cream of mushroom soup gives it a rich and indulgent feel, which aligns with your liking for midwestern-style casseroles. The addition of parmesan cheese also adds a nice depth of flavor, which might appeal to your taste. Additionally, the cooking time is relatively quick, taking about 40 minutes, which fits within your typical time frame for preparing a meal.
